chunks.content: HACKATHON CHALLENGE DOCUMENT AI Learning Companion for Competitive Exams DevClash2026 NIT Raipur Hackathon Challenge Brief Build an Autonomous AI Learning Companion for India's Competitive Exam Aspirants THE CORE MISSION Participants must design and build a working prototype of an AI-powered, retention-first learning system that acts as a proactive cognitive companion for students preparing for JEE, NEET, or UPSC. The system must go beyond content delivery. It must remember what a student studied, adapt to their pace, and act autonomously to ensure nothing is forgotten. SECTION 1 · THE CHALLENGE What Participants Must Build Teams must build a working prototype addressing at least 3 of the 5 core modules below. Teams addressing all 5 score higher. 1. Spaced Repetition & Retention Engine A system tracking every concept a student studies and using a forgetting-curve algorithm to automatically schedule the next revision. Must maintain a dynamic learner knowledge graph.

Incomplete submissions will be penalised in scoring. 1. Working Prototype / Demo A functional web or mobile application demonstrating the core modules built. GitHub Repository A public or shared repository with all source code, a clear README with setup instructions, environment/dependency files, and sample data or mock inputs for judges to reproduce the demo. 3. Technical Report (PDF, max 6 pages) Covering: (a) architecture diagram, (b) AI/ML models used and why, (c) data sources, (d) module descriptions, (e) known limitations and future scope. Technical depth is required. 4. Presentation Deck (max 10 slides)

Project Swap The 3 finalists are assigned each other's fully submitted GitHub repositories, demo builds, and technical reports. Each team gets 45 minutes to explore and audit the other two projects in a closed room — no interaction with the rival team allowed. 2. The Claim Presentation Each team gets 5 minutes to present their findings to the judges. They must: (a) clearly demonstrate the gap in the rival's project, and (b) live-demo that their own project has a working implementation of that exact feature. 4.
